wallet.title: Ipochi
wallet.subtitleClient: Kurikirana ibyo wishyuye abakozi ukoresheje Isoko.
wallet.simulatedNotice: Muri iyi demo, kwishyura bikoresha MTN Mobile Money y'igerageza. Nta mafaranga nyayo atangwa.
wallet.noTransactions: Nta bikorwa by'imari burahaba. Rangiza umurimo kugira ngo ubibone hano.
wallet.workerStep1Body: Saba umurimo ufunguye maze wemezwe n'ubuyobozi, bigatuma uhuzwa n'uwo mukorana.
wallet.workerStep2Body: Mwumvikane ku bisobanuro mu butumwa maze ukore akazi. Nta kwishyura mbere.
wallet.workerStep3Body: Akazi karangiye, umukiriya akwishyura na MTN Mobile Money. Ubona inyemezabwishyu.
wallet.clientStep1Body: Sobanura akazi maze ushyireho ingengo y'imari. Ubuyobozi burabisuzuma mbere yo kubugaragariza abakozi.
wallet.clientStep2Body: Umukozi narangiza, emeza ko akazi karangiye ku ikarita y'akazi.
wallet.clientStep3Body: Ishyura umukozi na MTN Mobile Money: emeza ubutumwa kuri telefoni ukoresheje PIN. Inyemezabwishyu iratangwa.
wallet.momoNotice: Kwishyura bikorwa na MTN Mobile Money. Buri bwishyu bufite inyemezabwishyu buri wese ashobora kugenzura.

settings.title: Igenamiterere
settings.subtitle: Genzura umwirondoro wawe rusange, kugaragara kw'aho uherereye, n'amakuru ya konti yawe.
settings.profileDescWorker: Amakuru yawe n'aho uherereye bigaragara ku mwirondoro wawe rusange, abakiriya bakabibona.
settings.profileDescOther: Amakuru yawe agaragara ku mwirondoro wawe rusange, abandi bakoresha bakabibona.
settings.securityDesc: Hindura ijambo ry'ibanga hano. Izindi telefoni cyangwa mudasobwa zinjiye kuri konti yawe zirasohorwa.
settings.exportDesc: Kuramo kopi y'ibyo Isoko ifite byose kuri konti yawe: umwirondoro wawe, ubuhanga bwoherejwe, imirimo, akazi, ubwishyu, ibitekerezo n'ubutumwa.

notifications.title: Amatangazo
notifications.desc: Amatangazo yo muri porogaramu ahora akora. Hitamo ubundi buryo bumwe bwo kumenyeshwa.
notifications.inAppAlways: Uzahora ubona amatangazo hano, uko waba wahisemo kose.
notifications.emailHint: Ku bijyanye no kwishyurwa, impinduka kuri konti, n'ibyemezo ku kazi kawe.
notifications.smsHint: Ku bijyanye no kwishyurwa, impinduka kuri konti, n'ibyemezo ku kazi kawe, binyuze mu butumwa bugufi.
notifications.smsPhoneInvalid: Andika nimero ya telefoni yo mu Rwanda itangirwa na 072, 073, 078 cyangwa 079.
notifications.smsCodeWrong: Iyo kode si yo. Usigaje amahirwe {{count}}.
notifications.smsCodeExpired: Iyi kode yarangiye. Saba indi nshya.
notifications.smsConsent: Niwemeza, uremera ko Isoko yohereza amatangazo kuri iyi nimero binyuze kuri Pindo, ikigo cyohereza ubutumwa bugufi mu Rwanda. Ushobora guhagarika ubutumwa bugufi hano igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
notifications.smsSender: Muri iki gihe cy'igerageza, ubutumwa buzaturuka kuri “{{sender}}” kandi butangire na “Isoko:”.
notifications.verifyPending: Nta meyili izoherezwa mbere y'uko wemeza iyi aderesi.
notifications.verifySent: Reba muri imeyili yawe umuhuza wo kwemeza.

settings.passwordMismatch: Amagambo y'ibanga yombi ntabwo ari kimwe.

settings.passwordChangeFailed: Ntibyakunze guhindura ijambo ry'ibanga. Ongera ugerageze.

settings.exportFailed: Ntibyashobotse gutegura amakuru yawe. Ongera ugerageze.

trust.title: Amanota y’ikizere
trust.provisional: Mushya kuri Isoko. Nta bitekerezo birahari. Ntabwo ari amanota make, ni uko atagira isuzuma.
trust.penalty: Yagabanyijwe amanota {{points}}: akazi {{count}} yaretse amaze kwemera mu minsi 90 ishize.
trust.formulaNote: Uburyo bwo kubara {{version}}. Ibitekerezo bya vuba bifite uburemere bwinshi, kandi amateka maremare aruta igitekerezo kimwe.
trust.reportIntro: Bwira itsinda rya Isoko ibyabaye. Bazabikurikirana; uwo uregwa ntabwirwa uwamureze.
trust.phoneConfirmedHint: Yemejwe na kode yoherejwe kuri telefoni ye
trust.emailConfirmedHint: Yemejwe n'ihuza ryoherejwe muri imeyili ye
trust.paymentOther: Witondere: ubwishyu bunyuze kuri Isoko gusa ni bwo bwandikwa, bugira inyemezabwishyu kandi burindwa n'impaka. Niwishyura hanze, nta wagufasha kuyagarura.
trust.paymentOwn: Kwishyura bikorerwe kuri Isoko: bibaha mwembi inyemezabwishyu n'uburinzi bw'impaka, kandi bibarwa mu mateka y'akazi kawe.
trust.contactNote: Gutanga nimero ni byiza mu gutegura uruzinduko. Kwishyura bikorerwe kuri Isoko kugira ngo akazi kabe karinzwe.
trust.adminSub: Ibyo abakoresha bareze bagenzi babo. Funga buri kimwe nk'icyakemuwe cyangwa icyanzwe; uwareze arabimenyeshwa.
trust.handledBody: Koresha ibi iyo wagize icyo ukora, urugero kuburira umukoresha. Uwareze abwirwa ko byakemuwe.
trust.dismissBody: Koresha ibi iyo nta gikenewe gukorwa. Uwareze abwirwa ko byasuzumwe.
trust.suspendBody: Ahita asohorwa kandi ntashobora kwinjira kugeza umuyobozi amusubije. Ikirego gifungwa nk'icyakemuwe.

matches.pendingWorkerPrompt: Watoranyijwe kuri aka kazi. Emeza ko uracyaboneka.
matches.pendingClientPrompt: Turategereje ko umukozi yemeza ko aboneka.
matches.declineExplainer: Aka kazi kazasubira ku isoko kugira ngo umukiriya atoranye undi.
matches.declineReasonPlaceholder: Impamvu (si ngombwa), urugero: nari mfite akandi kazi
matches.alreadyReviewed: Wamaze gutanga isuzuma kuri aka kazi.

verification.captureHint: Fata ifoto y’akazi warangije, cyangwa wiyandikire ijwi usobanura icyo wakoze.
verification.micDenied: Mikoro ntiboneka. Reba uburenganzira bwa mushakisha, cyangwa ufate ifoto.
verification.needEvidence: Shyiraho ifoto cyangwa ijwi, cyangwa wandike umurongo.
verification.evidenceFingerprint: Buri dosiye ifite ikimenyetso cyayo bwite, bityo ibimenyetso ntibishobora guhindurwa nyuma y'icyemezo.

passport.title: Pasiporo y’ubumenyi
passport.explainer: Umurongo na kode ya QR byerekana ubumenyi bwawe bwemejwe ku muntu wese, ndetse n’utari kuri Isoko. Wereke umukiriya abashe kubigenzura ako kanya.
passport.shareNote: Umuntu wese ufite uyu murongo ashobora kubona ubumenyi bwawe n’amateka y’akazi. Ushobora kuwukuraho igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
passport.verifiedNow: Byemejwe: aya makuru ahuye n’ayabitswe ubu.
passport.recordChanged: Aya makuru yahindutse kuva pasiporo yakorwa. Ayariho ubu ari hasi.
passport.footer: Ubumenyi bwemejwe bwasuzumwe n’abasuzuma bahawe akazi mu buryo bwikora, umukozi atabashobora gutoranya. Abasuzuma ntibavugwa amazina, kugira ngo bagume bigenga.
passport.statementFailed: Ntibyakunze gukora inyandiko y'amafaranga winjije. Ongera ugerageze.

income.title: Icyemezo cy’amafaranga winjije
income.explainer: Inyandiko ishyizweho umukono y’amafaranga wahembwe binyuze kuri Isoko. Ababaguriza na serivisi za mobile money barabigenzura, ibyo akazi k’amafaranga y’intoki kadashobora kwerekana.

common.themeHint: Hitamo nk’iya sisitemu yawe, cyangwa uhitemo imwe ihoraho.
common.noMatches: Nta guhuzwa birahari. Tanga akazi cyangwa uhuzwe na ko mbere.
common.mapHint: Utudomo twerekana aho akazi kari. Kanda kamwe ukafungure.

review.confidenceHint: Niba udahamya, bivuge. Undi musuzuma azazanwa aho kukubireka wenyine.

skills.specialisationHint: Si ngombwa. Guhitamo bidufasha kuguhuza n’akazi kakwiye.
skills.requiredLevelHint: Si ngombwa. Abakozi bari hasi y’uru rwego baracyashobora gusaba. Bashyirwa hasi ku rutonde, ntibahishwe.

experience.title: Uburambe bwawe
experience.hint: Bwira abakiriya ibyo wakoze mbere. Bigaragara ku mwirondoro wawe rusange.
experience.summaryPlaceholder: Urugero: imyaka itanu nsana telefoni i Nyamirambo, cyane cyane ibirahure n’aho bashyira umuriro.

credentials.title: Ibimenyetso by’ubumenyi

tierHelp.self_declared: Umukozi yatubwiye ko akora ibi. Nta wurabigenzura.
tierHelp.document_sighted: Usuzuma yarebye icyemezo umukozi yatanze. Ibyo byemeza ko inyandiko yabonywe. Si ukugenzura niba icyemezo ubwacyo ari ukuri.
tierHelp.peer_reviewed: Abasuzuma bigenga barebye ibimenyetso by’akazi barabyemeza. Abasuzuma bahabwa akazi mu buryo bwikora, umukozi ntashobora kubatoranya.
tierHelp.work_earned: Byubatswe ku kazi karangiye kandi gasuzumwe kuri Isoko.
tierHelp.supervised: Umukozi wemejwe yamushyigikiye nyuma y'akazi bishyuwe hamwe. Ni uburambe nyabwo, ariko uwamushyigikiye ntabogamye, bityo bifite agaciro gake ugereranyije n'isuzuma.

credentials.addHint: Fata ifoto y’icyemezo cyanditse cyangwa ushyireho PDF. Usuzuma azemeza ko yakibonye. Ntidushobora kugenzura icyemezo ubwacyo.
credentials.certTitlePlaceholder: Urugero: TVET Urwego rwa 3 muri Electronics
credentials.declareHint: Bwira abakiriya icyo ukora. Ushobora kongeraho ibimenyetso nyuma. Ubumenyi butagira ibimenyetso buracyagaragara, bwanditseho ko wivugiye.
credentials.honestNotice: Isoko yemeza ko usuzuma yabonye icyemezo cyawe. Ntiyemeza ko icyemezo ari ukuri, kandi ntiyigera ibivuga.

offline.offline: Nta murandasi ufite. Igikorwa {{count}} cyabitswe, kizoherezwa nubwo uzagaruka kuri interineti.
offline.offline_other: Nta murandasi ufite. Ibikorwa {{count}} byabitswe, bizoherezwa nubwo uzagaruka kuri interineti.
offline.savedOffline: Byabitswe. Bizoherezwa igihe uzagaruka kuri interineti.

verifyEmail.successBody: Ubu uzahabwa amatangazo ya Isoko kuri imeyili.
verifyEmail.failedBody: Ashobora kuba yarangiye cyangwa yakoreshejwe. Saba undi mushya muri Igenamiterere.
verifyEmail.missingToken: Uyu muhuza wuzuye. Ongera ufungure umuhuza uri muri imeyili yawe.

quote.priceHelp: Ingengo y'imari y'umukiriya ni {{budget}} RWF. Saba igiciro gikwiye akazi. Igiciro mwumvikanyeho ni cyo umukiriya akwishyura na Mobile Money akazi karangiye.
quote.notePlaceholder: Urugero: harimo ibikoresho, nshobora gutangira ku wa mbere

receipt.title: Inyemezabwishyu
receipt.scanHint: Sikana ugenzure iyi nyemezabwishyu mu nyandiko za Isoko.
receipt.notFoundHelp: Reba nimero iri ku nyemezabwishyu yacapwe. Inyemezabwishyu zibaho gusa ku kazi kishyuwe.

dispute.openBody: Abanyamuryango batatu ba Isoko batarakoranye n'umwe muri mwe bazasoma impande zombi bafate icyemezo ku byishyurwa. Ubwishyu burategereza.
dispute.reason_notReleased: Akazi karangiye ariko umukiriya ntiyemeje ko karangiye
dispute.detailsPlaceholder: Sobanura ibyo mwumvikanye n'ibyabaye. Abahuza barabisoma.
dispute.frozen: Hari impaka zifunguye kuri aka kazi. Ubwishyu burategereza icyemezo.
dispute.title: Ibirego
dispute.subtitle: Kutumvikana ku kazi karakorwa, gufatwaho icyemezo n'abakozi batatu batabogamye.
dispute.addSidePlaceholder: Sobanura ibyo mwumvikanye n'ibyabaye ku ruhande rwawe.
dispute.deadline: Kizafatwaho icyemezo bitarenze {{date}}, bitabaye ibyo umuyobozi akabikora
dispute.rationalePlaceholder: Kubera iki? Bizamenyeshwa impande zombi icyemezo kimaze gufatwa.
dispute.panelNote: Batoranyijwe ku bushake mu banyamuryango {{count}} bujuje ibisabwa.
dispute.withAdmin: Abahuza ntibumvikanye ku gihe; umuyobozi ni we ufata icyemezo.
dispute.means_release: Akazi gafatwa nk'akarangiye. Umukiriya yishyura {{amount}} RWF yose na Mobile Money.
dispute.means_split: Akazi gafatwa nk'akarangiye. Umukiriya yishyura kimwe cya kabiri cy'igiciro na Mobile Money.
dispute.how1Body: Akazi kakiri gukorwa, umukozi cyangwa umukiriya asobanura icyagenze nabi. Undi ashobora kongeraho uruhande rwe.
dispute.how2Body: Abakozi batatu b'inararibonye ba Isoko batarakoranye n'umwe muri bo basoma impande zombi bagatora mu minsi 5.
dispute.how3Body: Igiciro cyose, kimwe cya kabiri, cyangwa guhagarika. Umukiriya yishyura ibisabwa na Mobile Money.

chat.tooBig: Ifoto igomba kuba munsi ya MB 10.

jobPhotos.title: Amafoto y'akazi
jobPhotos.hint: Agera kuri 3. Agaragara mu mateka y'akazi kawe akazi kamaze kwishyurwa.
jobPhotos.failed: Ntibyashyizweho. Amafoto agomba kuba ari munsi ya MB 10.

rejection.title: Kubera iki wanze ubu busabe?
rejection.help: Umukozi arabibona, kugira ngo amenye icyo yanoza.
rejection.notePlaceholder: Hari icyo wongeraho? (si ngombwa, umukozi arakibona)
rejection.breakdownHelp: Hakurikijwe ubumenyi. Kwangwa kenshi kubera ubumenyi bike mu bumenyi bumwe byerekana aho amahugurwa akenewe.

rates.basis_paid: Bishingiye ku kazi {{count}} kishyuwe kuri Isoko.
rates.basis_posted: Bishingiye ku ngengo {{count}} zatanzwe; akazi kishyuwe ntikaraba kenshi.
rates.belowClient: Ibi biri munsi y’ibyo akazi nk’aka gakunze kwishyurwa. Abakozi beza bashobora kubyirengagiza.
rates.belowWorker: Igiciro cyawe kiri munsi y’ibisanzwe. Reba ko gihagije ku gihe n’ibikoresho byawe.
rates.belowAdmin: Biri munsi y'ibisanzwe muri uyu mwuga.

gigApproval.approveBody: Gahita gatangira kandi abakozi ba mbere bagatumirwa.

team.title: Itsinda
team.apprenticeHelp: Umuntu wiga umwuga akorana nawe kuri aka kazi. Ushobora kumuha igice cy’ubwishyu, kugeza kuri 30%. Abakozi bemejwe muri uyu mwuga ni bo bonyine bashobora kugira umunyeshuri.
team.endorseHelp: Kumushyigikira byandika aka kazi nk’uburambe bwagenzuwe ku mwirondoro we. Ntibyemeza ubumenyi.
team.crewHelp: Vuga abantu bagera kuri 4 mukorana n’igice cy’ubwishyu cyabo. Wowe usigarana nibura 10%.
team.memberOnly: Uri kuri aka kazi nka {{role}}. Uyobora ni we ukurikirana ubwishyu.

adminNav.gigApprovalsSub: Akazi gashya gategereza hano kugeza umuyobozi akagenzuye. Emeza kugira ngo gatangire; abakozi ba mbere bahita batumirwa.
adminNav.skillReviewsSub: Ubumenyi bwoherejwe butegereje icyemezo, n’ibimenyetso byabwo.
adminNav.jobsSub: Akazi gakorwa n’akazi karangiye, n’aho amafaranga ageze.
adminNav.paymentsSub: Ubwishyu bwa Mobile Money: byishyuwe, bitegereje kwemezwa n'umukiriya, akazi kataristishyurwa, n'amafaranga yoherejwe ku bakozi.
adminNav.usersSub: Hagarika konti kugira ngo itinjira ako kanya, cyangwa uyisibe burundu.
adminNav.reviewersSub: Abasuzuma ibimenyetso by’ubumenyi. Abakozi bafite amanota meza; amategeko yo guhinduranya ni yo agena ubona iki.
adminNav.auditSub: Ibimenyetso by’abasuzuma n’abakozi bashobora kubogama. Ikimenyetso ni ugusaba kureba, si icyemezo.
adminNav.metricsSub: Ibipimo by’ibibazo by’ubushakashatsi: ese gutondekanya bituma akazi kemerwa, kandi abashya babona amahirwe angana?
adminNav.marketSub: Ibyo akazi kishyurwa koko muri buri mwuga, n’impamvu ubusabe bwangwa.

actions.approveApplicantBody: Arasabwa kwemeza ko akiboneka; abandi basabye bategereza kugeza abyemeje.
actions.suspendBody: Arasohorwa kandi ntashobora kwinjira kugeza yongeye gukora.
actions.deleteBody: Bisiba burundu konti ye n’ibiyifitanye isano byose. Ntibishobora gusubizwa inyuma.

attention.reviewDetailWorker: Tanga amanota ku mukiliya usoze akazi
attention.reviewDetailClient: Tanga amanota ku mukozi usoze akazi
attention.inProgressWorker: Umukiriya akwishyura na Mobile Money akazi karangiye
attention.inProgressClient: Emeza ko karangiye akazi kamaze gukorwa

protection.title: Birinzwe na Isoko
protection.receiptDetail: Umuntu wese ashobora kuyigenzura, kandi yanditse ku nyandiko y’amafaranga y’umukozi.
protection.momoDetail: Umukiriya yishyura umukozi na MTN MoMo akazi karangiye.
protection.cover: Job Cover ku kazi ko hanze
protection.coverDetail: Umukiriya ashobora kwishingira amafaranga yo kuvuza umukozi aramutse akomerekeye ku kazi.

fairwork.title: Ikarita ya Fairwork
fairwork.subtitle: Isoko isuzumwe hakurikijwe amahame atanu ya Fairwork ku kazi ko kuri porogaramu, hashingiwe ku nyandiko zayo, bibarwa buri gihe iyi paji ifunguwe.
fairwork.about: Fairwork, yo muri Oxford Internet Institute, isuzuma porogaramu z’akazi mu bihugu 38 ku bwishyu, imiterere, amasezerano, imiyoborere n’uburenganzira bwo guhagararirwa, amanota abiri kuri buri hame. Natwe twisuzuma ku mahame amwe, ako kanya, tukerekana umubare uri inyuma ya buri nota.
fairwork.c_payAtFloor: Akazi kishyurwa nibura igiciro gito gisanzwe mu mwuga
fairwork.c_payAtFloor_d: Igice cy’ubwishyu kiri kuri cyangwa hejuru y’igiciro gito gisanzwe muri uwo mwuga kuri Isoko.
fairwork.c_disputesOnTime_d: Igice cy’impaka zafashweho icyemezo, cyangwa zikiri mu minsi 5.
fairwork.c_explained_d: Igice cy’ubusabe n’ubutumire bifite impamvu zo gutondekanywa.
fairwork.c_appealsHandled_d: Igice cy’ubujurire bwafashweho icyemezo, cyangwa bukiri mu minsi 14.
fairwork.c_workerVoice: Abakozi batora ku mategeko ya porogaramu
fairwork.c_workerVoice_d: Ntibirashyirwaho: abakozi nta buryo bafite bwo gutora ku mategeko y'urubuga.
fairwork.c_paidThroughIsoko_d: Igipimo cy'akazi karangiye umukozi wako yishyuwe binyuze kuri Isoko na Mobile Money.

safetyNet.title: Ubwizigame bw’ingoboka
safetyNet.subtitle: Amafaranga abakiliya bawe bongeyeho y’iminsi y’uburwayi n’ibyihutirwa. Ni ayawe kuyakoresha.
safetyNet.ejoHezaHelp: Shyira ku ruhande iki gice cya buri bwishyu cyo kuzigamira Ejo Heza, gahunda y’u Rwanda yo kuzigama igihe kirekire.
safetyNet.whyPlaceholder: Urugero: kujya kwa muganga, ubukode igihe urwaye
safetyNet.empty: Nta kintu kiraba. Umukiliya niyongera ku bwizigame bwawe, bizagaragara hano.
safetyNet.addHelp: {{amount}} RWF bijya ku bwizigame bw’umukozi akazi karangiye kwishyurwa.
safetyNet.noneHelp: Ushobora kongeraho make y’iminsi y’uburwayi n’ibyihutirwa by’umukozi.
safetyNet.simulated: Kohereza muri Ejo Heza ni ibyo kugerageza muri iyi demo.

growth.title: Iterambere
growth.subtitle: Urwego rwawe, icyo urukurikira rusaba, intego y’ukwezi, n’aho akazi kari.
growth.levelsPublic: Ibisabwa byose birazwi. Ubona neza icyo buri rwego rusaba.
growth.availabilityHelp: "Sindi hafi" bigukura ku rutonde rw’abatoranywa kugeza ku itariki uhitamo. "Mfite akazi kenshi" ntibibuza abakiliya kukubona.
growth.goalNone: Shyiraho intego y’uku kwezi uyikurikirane uko wishyurwa.
growth.ladderHelp: Buri ntambwe ni ikimenyetso gikomeye cy’ubumenyi bwawe.
growth.nextStep_self_declared: Ibikurikira: ohereza akazi gasuzumwe, cyangwa wige ku mukozi wemejwe.
growth.nextStep_peer_reviewed: Ibikurikira: rangiza akazi 3 kishyuwe kasuzumwe muri uyu mwuga.
growth.rplHelp: Gahunda ya RPL ya Rwanda TVET Board yemeza ubumenyi bwigiwe hanze y’ishuri. Capa ibimenyetso byawe bya Isoko ubijyane mu isuzuma.
growth.demandHelp: Akazi gafunguye mu mwuga wawe, ukurikije agace, n’ibyo akazi nk’ako kishyurwa.
growth.noDemand: Nta kazi gafunguye mu mwuga wawe ubu.

rpl.title: Ibimenyetso byo Kwemeza Ubumenyi (RPL)
rpl.subtitle: Ubumenyi n’akazi kishyuwe byanditswe kuri Isoko

safety.title: Umutekano
safety.contactHelp: Uwo wizera abona ubutumwa iyo ugeze ku kazi, iyo ukavuyemo, n’ako kanya iyo ukanze SOS.
safety.contactPhoneHelp: Nimero ya MTN cyangwa Airtel Rwanda.
safety.checkedIn: Wanditse ko wageze. Uwo wizera yamenyeshejwe.
safety.checkedOut: Wanditse ko wavuye. Uwo wizera yamenyeshejwe ko wavuye amahoro.
safety.sosBody: Uwo wizera ahita amenyeshwa n’abayobozi bose ba Isoko, n’aho uri niba telefoni ibyemera.
safety.noContact: Nta muntu wizera uranditse, nta wuzamenyeshwa.
safety.adminSub: SOS n’ibisurwa bitavuyemo. Bikemure, hanyuma ubyandike.

voice.denied: Emerera mikoro kugira ngo ufate ijwi.
voice.gigHint: Sobanura akazi mu ijwi, mu rurimi urwo ari rwo rwose, kugeza ku minota 2. Abakozi barabwumva iruhande rw'ibisobanuro byanditse.

authPanel.title: Hindura ubumenyi bwawe amafaranga.
authPanel.body: Isoko ihuza abakozi b'abahanga i Kigali n'abakeneye akazi kabo. Tanga akazi, uhuzwe, wishyurwe mu mutekano.

cover.policyLine: Polisi {{policy}} · amafaranga yo kwivuza kugeza kuri {{limit}} RWF iyo habayeho impanuka kuri aka kazi
cover.claimIntro: Tubwire ibyabaye n'ikiguzi cyo kwivuza. Job Cover yishyura amafaranga yo kwivuza kugeza kuri {{limit}} RWF, ku busabe bukozwe mu gihe cy'akazi cyangwa mu minsi {{days}} nyuma yo kwishyurwa.
cover.whatHappenedHint: Urugero: nikomerekeje ku kiganza ku meza yo gukatiraho, banyondora inshinge eshatu ku kigo nderabuzima.
cover.claimSent: Ubusabe bwoherejwe. Umuyobozi azabusuzuma kandi uzamenyeshwa icyemezo.
cover.addHelp: Irinda {{name}} ku mafaranga yo kwivuza, kugeza kuri {{limit}} RWF, aramutse akomerekeye kuri aka kazi.
cover.adminSub: Ubusabe bw'indishyi bw'abakozi ku kazi karinzwe. Emeza kugira ngo umwishingizi yishyure, cyangwa wange utanga impamvu; umukozi abimenyeshwa uko byagenda kose. Umwishingizi ni uw'igerageza muri iki cyiciro.
cover.approveBody: Umwishingizi yishyura {{amount}} RWF yo kuvuza umukozi.

workers.title: Shaka abakozi
workers.subtitle: Hitamo ukora akazi. Buri bumenyi bwerekana uko bwemejwe, kandi wishyura na Mobile Money ari uko akazi karangiye.
workers.offerIntro: Hitamo kimwe mu kazi kawe gafunguye. {{name}} arasabwa kwemeza; wishyura na Mobile Money akazi karangiye.
workers.noOpenGigs: Nta kazi gafunguye ufite. Akazi gafunguka umuyobozi amaze kukemeza.

pay.inProgressClient: {{name}} narangiza, emeza ko akazi karangiye. Hanyuma wishyura {{amount}} na MTN Mobile Money.
pay.inProgressWorker: Nurangiza, {{name}} yemeza ko akazi karangiye akakwishyura {{amount}} na MTN Mobile Money.
pay.markDoneBody: Bikore {{name}} amaze kurangiza akazi. Hanyuma uzishyura {{amount}} na Mobile Money.
pay.coverOffer: Ongeraho Job Cover ku {{premium}}: yishyura amafaranga yo kuvuza {{name}} kugeza kuri {{limit}} aramutse akomerekeye kuri aka kazi. Yishyurwa hamwe n'ubwishyu bwawe.
pay.coverAdded: Job Cover yongeweho. Izishyurwa hamwe n'ubwishyu bwawe.
pay.title: Ishyura {{name}} na MTN Mobile Money
pay.howItWorks: Uzabona ubutumwa bwa MoMo kuri telefoni yawe. Andika PIN yawe ubyemeze.
pay.approveBody: Ubutumwa bwa MoMo bwoherejwe kuri {{number}}. Andika PIN yawe ubyemeze. Niba ntacyo ubonye, kanda *182*7*1# urebe ibitegereje kwemezwa.
pay.failedBefore: Ubwishyu bwawe buheruka ntibwakunze. Reba nimero wongere ugerageze.
pay.awaitingClient: Akazi karangiye. {{name}} azakwishyura {{amount}} na Mobile Money.
pay.awaitingApproval: {{name}} yatangiye kwishyura {{amount}} na Mobile Money kandi arabyemeza kuri telefoni ye.
pay.disputeOpen: Hari impaka zifunguye kuri aka kazi. Abahuza ni bo bafata icyemezo ku byishyurwa; ubwishyu burategereza.

inbox.title: Imenyesha
inbox.emptyHint: Amakuru ku mirimo yawe, kwishyurwa n'impaka azagaragara hano.

avatar.title: Ifoto y'umwirondoro
avatar.hint: Ifoto igaragaza neza isura yawe ifasha abakiriya n'abakozi kukwizera. JPEG, PNG cyangwa WebP.
avatar.removeConfirm: Gusiba ifoto yawe? Inyuguti z'izina ryawe zizagaragara aho.
avatar.cropHint: Kurura ifoto ushyire isura yawe mu ruziga. Koresha umurongo kugira ngo wegereze.
avatar.wrongType: Hitamo ifoto ya JPEG, PNG cyangwa WebP.
avatar.tooLarge: Iyo foto ni nini cyane. Hitamo iri munsi ya MB 15.

support.title: Ubufasha
support.subtitle: Ibisubizo by'ibibazo bikunze kubazwa, n'umurongo ugera ku itsinda rya Isoko.
support.heroBody: Shakisha igisubizo, cyangwa uhitemo ingingo. Niba ugikeneye ubufasha, itsinda rya Isoko risubiza hano, akenshi mu munsi umwe.
support.searchPlaceholder: Shakisha igisubizo, urugero: ubutumwa bwa MoMo
support.searchNoResults: Nta gisubizo gihuye n'ibyo. Twandikire tugufashe.
support.catHint_safety: Kumva utari mu mutekano ku kazi
support.contactCta: Twandikire, itsinda rya Isoko rizagusubiza hano, akenshi mu munsi umwe.
support.safetyNow: Niba uri mu kaga ubu, banza uhamagare 112. Hanyuma utubwire hano, tuzahita tubyitaho.
support.noRequests: Ntabwo uravugana n'ubufasha. Nubikora, ubusabe bwawe n'ibisubizo byacu bizagaragara hano.
support.formIntro: Tubwire ibyabaye. Uko utanga ibisobanuro byinshi, ni ko tugufasha vuba.
support.subject: Umutwe
support.messagePlaceholder: Byagenze bite, kandi wari witeze iki? Shyiramo amatariki n'amafaranga niba bijyanye n'amafaranga.
support.attach: Ongeraho ifoto ya ecran cyangwa PDF
support.closeConfirm: Gufunga ubu busabe? Ushobora gutangiza ubundi igihe cyose.
support.closedNote: Ubu busabe bwafunzwe. Tangiza ubundi niba ukeneye ubundi bufasha.
support.ratedNo: Twongeye gufungura ubusabe bwawe, tuzongera tubirebe.
support.waitingHint: Itsinda ryagusubije. Subiza hepfo kugira ngo dukomeze.
support.openHint: Twabonye ubutumwa bwawe. Itsinda rizagusubiza hano, akenshi mu munsi umwe.
support.system_not_helpful: Byavuzwe ko bitakemutse, bityo bwongeye gufungurwa.
support.system_escalated_dispute: Byahindutse impaka, kugira ngo abahuza bigenga bafate icyemezo.
support.guestSubtitle: Ntushobora kwinjira? Tubwire ibiri kuba, tuzagusubiza kuri imeyili.
support.name: Izina ryawe
support.emailHint: Twohereza kuri iyi aderesi umurongo wihariye wo gukurikirana ubusabe bwawe.
support.guestSentBody: Twakoherereje kuri imeyili umurongo wihariye wo kubukurikirana no gusubiza. Reba mu bubiko bwawe, no muri spam niba butarimo.
support.guestInvalid: Uyu murongo ntukora. Koresha umurongo uri muri imeyili twakoherereje.

payment.q1: Ubutumwa bwa Mobile Money ntibwagaragaye kuri telefoni yanjye
payment.a1: Kanda *182*7*1# urebe ubwishyu butegereje kwemezwa, ubwemeze ukoresheje PIN yawe. Niba butarimo, fungura akazi wongere ukande Ishyura; ntuzakatwa kabiri.
payment.q2: Narishyuye ariko akazi kakigaragaza ko gategereje
payment.a2: Rimwe na rimwe MTN itinda iminota mike kwemeza. Isoko igenzura buri munota, akazi kakagaragaza ko kishyuwe MTN ikimara kwemeza. Niba nyuma y'isaha bigitegereje, twandikire utubwire igihe wabyemereje.
payment.a3: Fungura Igikapu. Buri kazi kishyuwe gafite nimero y'inyemezabwishyu; uyikanzeho ifunguka, kandi umuntu wese ashobora kuyigenzura ku rupapuro rwayo.

account.a1: Ku rupapuro rwo kwinjira hitamo “Wibagiwe ijambo ry'ibanga?” wandike imeyili iri kuri konti yawe. Umurongo twohereza ukora mu isaha imwe.
account.a2: Reba ko nimero itangira na 072, 073, 078 cyangwa 079. Kode ishobora gutinda umunota; ushobora gusaba indi nyuma yo kubara. Niba nimero yemejwe kuri indi konti, ntishobora gukoreshwa kabiri.
account.a3: Jya muri Igenamiterere › Umwirondoro, ukande Shyiraho ifoto, ushyire isura yawe mu ruziga maze ukande Byarangiye.

skills.q1: Isuzuma ry'ubuhanga rimara igihe kingana iki?
skills.a1: Abakozi babiri bafite uburambe mu mwuga wawe basuzuma buri cyo wohereje, akenshi mu minsi ibiri. Uhabwa ubutumwa bukubwira icyemezo cyabo.
skills.a2: Ubutumwa buvuga impamvu. Ushobora kujurira uhereye kuri Igenamiterere › Ibimenyetso by'ubuhanga, cyangwa ukohereza ibindi bimenyetso nk'amafoto y'akazi warangije.
skills.a3: Amafoto asobanutse cyangwa videwo ngufi y'akazi wikoreye, impamyabumenyi, cyangwa ubuhamya bw'uwo wakoreye.

job.q1: Jye n'undi muntu ntitwumvikana ku kazi
job.a1: Ku ikarita y'akazi hitamo “Fungura impaka”. Abahuza batatu bigenga bareba ibyo mwembi muvuga bagafata icyemezo gikwiye.
job.a2: Banza umwoherereze ubutumwa. Natasubiza, fungura impaka: abahuza bashobora gushyira akazi nk'akarangiye ukishyurwa.
job.q3: Umuntu yansabye kwishyura cyangwa kwishyurwa hanze ya Isoko
job.a3: Ntubikore. Ubwishyu bunyuze muri Isoko gusa ni bwo bugira inyemezabwishyu, Job Cover n'uburinzi bw'impaka. Ushobora kumutanga uhereye ku mwirondoro we.

safety.q1: Ndumva ntari mu mutekano ku kazi ubu
safety.a1: Va aho niba ubishoboye uhamagare 112. Ku kazi gakorerwa aho kari, buto ya SOS imenyesha umuntu wawe wizewe n'itsinda rya Isoko.
safety.a2: Iyandikishe ugeze kandi wiyandukure ugiye. Nutiyandukura, umuntu wawe wizewe n'itsinda barabimenyeshwa.
safety.a3: Mutange uhereye ku mwirondoro we, cyangwa utwandikire hano. Uwatanze ntajya amenyeshwa uwatanzwe.

bug.a1: Reba interineti yawe, hanyuma wongere ufungure urupapuro. Bikomeje, twandikire wohereze ifoto ya ecran n'icyo wakanze.
bug.a2: Ibyo wakoze birabikwa bikoherezwa interineti igarutse. Ntukeneye kongera gukanda.
bug.q3: Porogaramu igaragara nabi kuri telefoni yanjye
bug.a3: Twoherereze ifoto ya ecran n'ubwoko bwa telefoni. Guhindukiza telefoni cyangwa kuvugurura mushakisha akenshi bifasha.

other.a1: Mu igerageza Isoko ntica amafaranga ku kazi. Job Cover itari itegeko yishyurwa hamwe n'ubwishyu.
other.a2: Yego rwose. Twandikire uduhe igitekerezo; itsinda risoma buri gitekerezo.
other.q3: Nasiba nte konti yanjye cyangwa nkabona amakuru yanjye?
other.a3: Kuramo amakuru yawe muri Igenamiterere › Amakuru yawe. Gusiba konti, twandikire tuzabikora.
